from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u097/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-8be60265.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == background:
                    continue
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if not (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == color):
                    continue
                # Extend both ends of a diagonal run; an existing non-background
                # cell naturally blocks the ray on the end facing the motif.
                for sr, sc in ((-dr, -dc), (dr, dc)):
                    rr, cc = (r, c) if (sr, sc) == (-dr, -dc) else (nr, nc)
                    rr += sr
                    cc += sc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == background:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr += sr
                        cc += sc
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path)
